title: gouldia terminalis var. coriacea
intro: Gouldia terminalis var. coriacea, commonly known as the Coriaceous Gouldia, is a type of plant species that belongs to the family Myrtaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine and is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Gouldia terminalis var. coriacea include wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a sought-after remedy for various skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
